# Telegram Channel Scraper

> An Apify actor that exports messages from Telegram channels (text, date, views, media, forwards, links), with an optional channel summary and the channel's visible discussion members, without a login.

## Docs

- [Apify Store page](https://apify.com/goat255/telegram-channel-scraper): run it, prices, input form
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): input and output fields, MCP and HTTP setup for AI agents
- [README.md](README.md): overview, use cases and a demo video

## Quick call

- POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/goat255~telegram-channel-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN with body {"channels": ["example_channel"], "maxMessagesPerChannel": 50}

- [All our actors](https://apify.com/goat255)
